answer: The mirror test I would run is Signed alumni association membership with university attestation: an alumni record the university confirms, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so an alumni record the university confirms stays private; the pulse is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the wander of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
